title: 星巴克CEO：全客群销售强劲，客流与客单价双升
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Fresh off of last night's earnings reports, 7.9% comp growth, Brian. Obviously the street likes what they hear. But I do need to get a little bit more color as to exactly where that
segments.zh: 昨晚财报刚出，同店销售增长7.9%，布莱恩。显然市场对此反应积极。但我需要更多细节，了解增长具体来自哪里。

segments.en: is coming from. Transactions, 4.2%. That's foot traffic, Brian. Is that just favorable comp?
segments.zh: 交易量增长4.2%，这是客流量，布莱恩。这只是有利的同店数据吗？

segments.en: Are you truly getting more people into the store? Yeah, no. Great to be here. And look, the reality is what's terrific to see is the growth is coming from more customers coming to Starbucks more often.
segments.zh: 是真的有更多顾客进店吗？是的，很高兴来到这里。实际上，令人欣喜的是增长来自于更多顾客更频繁地光顾星巴克。

segments.en: And that's just a foundational strength. And the good news is we're seeing it across all income groups and really all age groups. So just really terrific strength moving through our stores.
segments.zh: 这是基础实力的体现。好消息是，我们在所有收入群体和年龄群体中都看到了这一趋势。门店表现非常强劲。

segments.en: With regards to the tickets as well, that was also up about 3.5% in the most recent quarter. So it's a function of both foot traffic coming into the store, but also people spending more.
segments.zh: 关于客单价，最近一季度也上涨了约3.5%。所以增长既来自进店客流，也来自顾客消费增加。

segments.en: Are they buying more? Are these add-ons? What gets that ticket price up to that 3.5% job?
segments.zh: 他们是买得更多了吗？还是追加购买？是什么推动了客单价上涨3.5%？

segments.en: Yeah, so what you're referring there is we're seeing people add more food, so higher attach rate. And then what we're also seeing is people modifying more of their drinks with
segments.zh: 是的，我们看到顾客增加了食品搭配，所以附加率更高。同时，我们也看到顾客更多地在饮品中添加冷萃奶泡或浓缩咖啡等。

segments.en: things like our cold foam, adding an espresso shot. So it really is terrific to see people using our menu to get them the customized experience that they want out of their drink. And then also
segments.zh: 所以，看到顾客利用我们的菜单获得他们想要的定制化饮品体验，并且搭配上美味的食品，这真的很棒。

segments.en: attaching what is really some terrific food to go along with their beverage. Do you have any concerns about maintaining this momentum? And I don't necessarily mean that from an operational
segments.zh: 您是否担心这种势头能否持续？我指的不一定是运营层面。我们刚发布了第二季度GDP报告，虽然滞后，但数据较为疲软。

segments.en: perspective. We just got a GDP report for the second quarter. Backwards looking much lighter than
segments.zh: 从运营角度看，您是否担心维持这一增长势头？我们刚看到第二季度GDP数据，虽然滞后，但表现较弱。
